name: thank-you-page-for-marriage
description: A scroll-driven "thank you for marrying me" letter website: a sealed letter, her phone's passcode, then a little museum of your story.

scripts.pages:dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788 --binding SITE_SECRET=local-test-secret-only
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name thank-you-page --branch main --commit-dirty=true
